module.name: Concurrency Count
module.changelog: *2.1.0 (27 August 2026)* Renames the everyday dashboard to Live View, adds a read-only fullscreen-capable Live Wall with up to three configurable featured trunks, persistent trunk visibility and ordering, accessible card reordering, and independent per-trunk unattended monitoring controls with GUI and CLI parity. *2.0.1 (27 August 2026)* Historical Trunk Concurrency results show compact peak occurrences inline beneath each trunk with accessible lazy call details. Historical Report tabs are now created only when a validated report is run, support persistent custom names, and provide clearer hover and long-name handling. *2.0.0 (26 August 2026)* Initial release. UI module port of the Concurrency Count CLI tool. Calculates maximum concurrent calls per PJSIP trunk, extension, or group within a date range, with a Live Command Centre (AMI-backed current state, threshold alerts via a supervised PM2 worker), persistent Historic Report tabs (up to five, saved report definitions restored across sessions), an optional 'sweep' calculation engine alongside the original per-second occupancy algorithm, and email/download output.
module.description: Live and historical PJSIP concurrency visibility with configurable Live View and read-only Live Wall dashboards, threshold monitoring and alerting, historical trunk, extension and PBX-wide group reporting, and GUI/CLI management. NOT CURRENTLY SUITABLE FOR PRODUCTION.
